readiness.reason: No useful rule among 81 preregistered candidates: selected combined fragment recall 5/120 train and 0/40 calibration; induced-error recovery 4/38 train and 0/8 calibration. Burden/harm pass but recall/recovery gates fail. Do not execute the final test under this rejected operating point.

classifier.tile_scores: unit-normalized image/text cosine similarity; frozen class prompts; top ceil(0.05*N) tiles averaged separately per class; argmax ties benign
classifier.validity: Engineering zero-shot development baseline, not clinically validated cancer detection.

review_policy.objective: Identify visually inconsistent and consequential components for pathologist review; never declare foreignness from decision change alone.
review_policy.visual: Median component tile distance to mean of up to five nearest outside-component cosine neighbors; training-only unmodified quantiles, strict greater-than threshold.
review_policy.influence: Baseline cancer-minus-benign margin minus leave-one-component-out margin; combined threshold inclusive.
review_policy.observed_geometry: RGB foreground area at measured overview pixel scale; isolation is a bounding-box distance lower bound against all observed tissue, not a pathologist-confirmed boundary.
review_policy.unknown_topology: Retain unassigned tiles; mapping below 90% abstains; abstentions count as missed positive trials, remain in clean-slide burden denominators. Empty counterfactual is unevaluable, never benign.

development_config.visual_aggregation: median of tile distances to mean of up to five nearest outside-component cosine neighbors
development_config.selection: Train only: satisfy all burden/harm constraints; maximize fragment recall then induced-error recovery, then minimize negative-control alerts and burden. Validate the single selected rule on calibration without retuning. If either split fails, do not authorize final prediction.

contamination.scenario: S1: native mask-annotated cancer tissue added to benign host, same Radboud provider, distinct slide, same split
contamination.fraction_definition: 100 * foreign tile count / original host tile count; count=ceil(percent*N/100)
contamination.connectivity: 4-connected native donor sampled tiles, no gaps, largest component; connected nested prefixes
contamination.pairing: Deterministic SHA256(seed/host/donor), prioritize donors with capacity for maximum dose; otherwise largest capacity, hash ties; same recorded coordinate geometry; never substitute slides or borrow development donors.
contamination.exclusions: No eligible donor or insufficient fixed donor capacity is recorded with requested/realized contamination. No replacement draws. All successful positive trials require exact oracle recovery; failure stops evaluation.

statistical_analysis_plan.primary_unit: Unique slide; no verified patient IDs. Different slides are not verified different patients.
statistical_analysis_plan.clean: All 24 slides, benign versus any ISUP>0 cancer; confusion rows truth/columns prediction, balanced accuracy and class support. Never treat slide-level grade as per-tile truth.
statistical_analysis_plan.classification_uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 stratified resamples of unique slides within benign/cancer; class recall Wilson95.
statistical_analysis_plan.contamination: Report each dose: unique hosts, originally correct and initially wrong separately; newly induced errors divided by originally correct hosts only. Prediction changes include reversals of pre-existing errors and are distinct. Report all capacity exclusions and zero-dose clean aliases.
statistical_analysis_plan.detector: Per dose and aggregate: known-foreign tile recall, any-hit fragment recall and complete-fragment recall; unmodified slide alerts, mean/max flagged components, mapped coverage/abstentions, genuine annotated cancer components/slides/tiles flagged and unknown-mask cases; no true-foreign precision claim from injected positives.
statistical_analysis_plan.hypothetical_filtering: Report damage among originally correct unmodified slides and recovery among new-error trial instances, with raw counts and unique affected hosts. Filtering is a diagnostic calculation, never a tissue-deletion action.
statistical_analysis_plan.uncertainty: 95% Wilson for unique-slide binary outcomes at each dose; aggregate tile/fragment recall and induced-error recovery use 2000 unique-host bootstrap resamples retaining every dose per host, conditional on fixed donors. Shared donors and unknown patient overlap limit population inference. No trial-as-patient intervals.
statistical_analysis_plan.comparisons: Fixed combined, visual-only, decision-only, spatial-only and 20 size/burden matched random draws. Draws are repeated controls, not independent observations. Zero-flag matched controls are uninformative.
statistical_analysis_plan.missing_data: No invented annotations, score substitutions or quality-based label exclusions. Mask-unavailable tissue remains unknown for genuine-cancer controls. Capacity/exclusion denominators and empty counterfactuals reported.
statistical_analysis_plan.finality: One predeclared final execution after an independently supported development protocol. No threshold/model/prompt/topology/donor revision after final outcomes, no p-value fishing, no claim of clinical floater detection.
